script.code:
SELECT u.kind, u.doc_no
  FROM ((SELECT 'GR' AS kind, g.gr_no AS doc_no
           FROM goods_receiving g
          WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
            AND g.is_deleted = 0
            AND g.gr_status = 'Draft'
            AND (JSON_CONTAINS(g.po_id, '{{node:code_pre.data.poIdSql}}') OR JSON_CONTAINS(g.po_id, JSON_QUOTE('{{node:code_pre.data.poIdSql}}')))
          ORDER BY g.id
          LIMIT 100)
        UNION ALL
        (SELECT 'PI' AS kind, p.purchase_invoice_no AS doc_no
           FROM purchase_invoice p
          WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
            AND p.is_deleted = 0
            AND p.pi_status = 'Draft'
            AND (JSON_CONTAINS(p.po_id, '{{node:code_pre.data.poIdSql}}') OR JSON_CONTAINS(p.po_id, JSON_QUOTE('{{node:code_pre.data.poIdSql}}')))
          ORDER BY p.id
          LIMIT 100)) u

SELECT CAST(l.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(l.received_qty AS CHAR) AS received_qty,
       CAST(l.created_received_qty AS CHAR) AS created_received_qty,
       CAST(l.invoice_qty AS CHAR) AS invoice_qty,
       CAST(l.return_quantity AS CHAR) AS return_quantity,
       CAST(l.created_return_qty AS CHAR) AS created_return_qty,
       l.line_status AS line_status,
       h.po_status AS head_po_status
  FROM purchase_order h
  LEFT JOIN purchase_order_2ukyuanr_sub l
    ON l.purchase_order_id = h.id AND l.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND l.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_pre.data.poIdSql}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       p.purchase_order_no,
       p.po_status,
       CAST(p.po_plant AS CHAR) AS po_plant,
       p.organization_id,
       p.po_supplier_id,
       (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(j.v) FROM JSON_TABLE(p.preq_id, '$[*]' COLUMNS (v VARCHAR(40) PATH '$')) j) AS preq_id_json,
       CAST(p.po_total AS CHAR) AS po_total,
       p.auto_pi,
       p.create_pi
  FROM purchase_order p
 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
   AND p.id = {{node:code_get_latest.data.poIdSql}}
   AND p.is_deleted = 0

SELECT CAST(l.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       l.item_id,
       CAST(l.quantity AS CHAR) AS quantity,
       CAST(l.quantity_uom AS CHAR) AS quantity_uom,
       CAST(l.preq_id AS CHAR) AS preq_id,
       CAST(l.preq_line_id AS CHAR) AS preq_line_id,
       CAST(l.parent_id AS CHAR) AS parent_id
  FROM purchase_order_2ukyuanr_sub l
 WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
   AND l.purchase_order_id = {{node:code_resolve_latest.data.poIdSql}}
   AND l.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY COALESCE(l.parent_id, l.id), l.parent_id IS NOT NULL, l.id

SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR), 'base_qty', u.base_qty))
          FROM item_mji552rc_sub u
         WHERE u.Item_id = i.id
           AND u.is_deleted = 0) AS uom_json
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(l.item_id AS UNSIGNED) AS mid
          FROM purchase_order_2ukyuanr_sub l
         WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
           AND l.purchase_order_id = {{node:code_resolve_latest.data.poIdSql}}
           AND l.is_deleted = 0
           AND l.item_id REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,19}$') sel
  JOIN item i
    ON i.id = sel.mid
   AND i.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0

SELECT CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(o.po_id AS CHAR) AS po_id,
       CAST(o.po_line_id AS CHAR) AS po_line_id,
       CAST(o.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,
       o.purchase_order_number,
       o.purchase_order_line,
       CAST(o.received_qty AS CHAR) AS received_qty
  FROM on_order_purchase_order o
 WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
   AND o.is_deleted = 0
   AND o.organization_id = '{{node:code_resolve_latest.data.orgSql}}'
   AND (o.po_id = {{node:code_resolve_latest.data.poIdSql}}
        OR o.purchase_order_number = CONVERT(UNHEX('{{node:code_resolve_latest.data.poNoHex}}') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
 ORDER BY o.id
